intro.en: Read the sentence, then tap the missing word.

items.text: The ___ is the one who tells the story.

why.en: Narrator = the storyteller.
why.zh: 叙述者 = 讲故事的人。

items.text: The words characters say inside speech marks are called ___.

why.en: Dialogue is inside " ". Cover it first!
why.zh: 对话在引号里，要先遮住！

items.text: I, me and my are clue words for ___ person.

why.en: The narrator is IN the story.
why.zh: 叙述者在故事里面。

items.text: You and your are clue words for ___ person.

why.en: The narrator talks to you, the reader.
why.zh: 叙述者对你（读者）说话。

items.text: He, she, they and names are clue words for ___ person.

why.en: The narrator is outside the story.
why.zh: 叙述者在故事外面。

items.text: A narrator who knows NOBODY's feelings, like a camera, is third person ___.

why.en: Objective = camera: only actions.
why.zh: 客观 = 摄像机：只有动作。

items.text: A narrator who knows the feelings of only ONE character is third person ___.

why.en: Limited = one mind.
why.zh: 有限 = 一个人的想法。

items.text: A narrator who knows EVERYONE's feelings is third person ___.

why.en: Omni = all.
why.zh: omni = 全部。

items.text: How a character sees something, because of their own life, is their ___.

why.en: Perspective = HOW they see it.
why.zh: 看法 = 怎样看。

items.text: The life lesson of a story, with no names, is the ___.

why.en: Theme = the lesson, not a summary.
why.zh: 主题 = 道理，不是概要。

intro.en: 10 questions, 30 seconds each. Faster answers win more points. Tip: cover the dialogue first!
intro.zh: 10 道题，每题 30 秒。答得越快分越高。小技巧：先遮住对话！

questions.q:
We packed our swimming bags and ran to catch the school bus.
What is the point of view?

why.en: Clue words: we, our. That is first person.
why.zh: 线索词：we、our，所以是第一人称。

questions.q:
Have you ever eaten durian? You will never forget the smell!
What is the point of view?

why.en: The narrator talks to YOU, the reader. That is second person.
why.zh: 叙述者在对“你”（读者）说话，所以是第二人称。

questions.q:
Sophie bought a photo card of her favourite singer. She smiled all the way home.
What is the point of view?

why.en: Clue words: Sophie, her, she. That is third person.
why.zh: 线索词：Sophie、her、she，所以是第三人称。

questions.q:
"You are my best friend!" Lily told Emma. Then they hugged.
What is the point of view?

why.en: Cover the dialogue first! "You" is inside the speech marks, so it does not count. Lily, Emma, they = third person.
why.zh: 先遮住对话！“You” 在引号里，不算。Lily、Emma、they = 第三人称。

questions.q:
"I won, I won!" Tom shouted. He held his gold medal high.
What is the point of view?

why.en: Cover the dialogue: "I won" does not count. Tom, he, his = third person.
why.zh: 遮住对话：“I won” 不算。Tom、he、his = 第三人称。

questions.q:
Have you ever visited a Thai temple? You must take off your shoes first.
What is the point of view?

why.en: Clue words: you, your. The narrator talks to the reader. That is second person.
why.zh: 线索词：you、your，叙述者在对读者说话，是第二人称。

questions.q:
James and Tom carried the bread to the hall. They put it on the long table.
Which kind of third person is it?

why.en: We only SEE actions. We know nobody's feelings, like a camera. That is objective.
why.zh: 我们只看到动作，不知道任何人的感受，像摄像机，所以是客观。

questions.q:
Lily wanted to sing on stage, but she was scared her voice would shake.
Which kind of third person is it?

why.en: We know the feelings of ONE person: Lily. That is limited.
why.zh: 我们只知道一个人（Lily）的感受，所以是有限。

questions.q:
Daisy felt proud of her drawing. Emma felt a little jealous, and the teacher was delighted.
Which kind of third person is it?

why.en: We know how EVERYONE feels: Daisy, Emma and the teacher. That is omniscient.
why.zh: 我们知道每个人的感受：Daisy、Emma 和老师，所以是全知。

questions.q:
The swimmers dived into the pool. The crowd clapped and cheered.
Which kind of third person is it?

why.en: Only actions, no feelings. Like a camera. That is objective.
why.zh: 只有动作，没有感受，像摄像机，所以是客观。

questions.q:
Sophie was nervous about the test, and Lily was worried about her too. Their teacher felt sure they would both do well.
Which kind of third person is it?

why.en: We know the feelings of Sophie, Lily AND the teacher. All of them = omniscient.
why.zh: 我们知道 Sophie、Lily 和老师的感受。所有人 = 全知。

questions.q:
Tom smiled at the new girl. He hoped she would sit next to him at lunch.
Which kind of third person is it?

why.en: We only know what Tom hopes. One person = limited.
why.zh: 我们只知道 Tom 的想法。一个人 = 有限。

questions.q:
It rains all day. Daisy is sad because her swimming lesson is cancelled. Farmer Tom is happy because his plants need water.
This shows that the two characters have different...

why.en: They see the SAME rain in different ways. HOW a character sees something is perspective.
why.zh: 他们看同一场雨的感受不同。人物怎样看一件事就是“看法”。

questions.q:
"Emma gave the card back to Sophie."
Is this a theme or a summary?

why.en: It tells WHAT HAPPENED and uses names. That is a summary.
why.zh: 它讲的是发生了什么，还有名字，所以是概要。

questions.q:
"Be honest, even when nobody is watching."
Is this a theme or a summary?

why.en: It is a life lesson for EVERYONE, with no names. That is a theme.
why.zh: 这是对每个人都适用的道理，没有名字，所以是主题。

canNow.en: I can now find the point of view and tell a theme from a summary.
canNow.zh: 我现在可以找出叙述视角，并分清主题和概要。

intro.en: Learn the key words, read the story, answer the questions, then write the theme.
intro.zh: 先学关键词，再读故事，回答问题，最后写出主题。

keywords.meaning: a small card with a picture of a singer
I felt sad and worried inside

keywords.zh: 她的脸一下子亮了起来（很开心）

keywords.meaning: happy and kind feelings in your heart

paragraphs: My name is Emma, and I love K-pop. On Monday, I found a photo card on the bus floor. It was my favourite singer, and it was very rare! I was so excited. I wanted to keep it.
Then I saw a younger girl at the back of the bus. She was crying and looking under every seat. "My sister gave it to me for my birthday," she said to her friend.
My heart felt heavy. I walked over and held out the card. "Is this yours?" I asked. The girl's face lit up. "Thank you so much!" she said. Her name was Sophie.
I did not have the rare card any more, but I felt warm and happy inside. It was a better feeling than keeping it.

questions.q: What is the point of view of this story?

why.en: Clue words outside the dialogue: My, I, me. That is first person.
why.zh: 对话外面的线索词：My、I、me，所以是第一人称。

questions.q: Who is the narrator?

why.en: "My name is Emma." Emma tells the story.
why.zh: “My name is Emma.” 是 Emma 在讲故事。

questions.q: How did Emma feel when she FIRST found the card?

why.en: Paragraph 1: "I was so excited."
why.zh: 第 1 段：“I was so excited.”

questions.q: Why was the card so special to Sophie?
options: It was a gift from her sister.
It cost a lot of money.

why.en: Paragraph 2: "My sister gave it to me for my birthday."
why.zh: 第 2 段：“My sister gave it to me for my birthday.”

questions.q: Which is the BEST theme of the story?
options: Emma found a card on the bus.
Doing the right thing feels better than keeping what is not yours.

why.en: A theme is a life lesson for everyone. The others are facts or a summary.
why.zh: 主题是对每个人都适用的道理。其他选项是事实或概要。

questions.q: Which sentence is the best SUMMARY of the story?
options: Emma found a rare photo card on the bus and gave it back to Sophie.

why.en: A summary tells WHAT HAPPENED, with names. "Be kind" is a theme, not a summary.
why.zh: 概要讲发生了什么，有名字。“Be kind” 是主题，不是概要。

questions.q: Why did Emma's heart feel heavy?
options: She saw Sophie crying and looking for the card.
She lost her own photo card.
She did not like K-pop any more.

why.en: Paragraphs 2 and 3: she saw the girl crying and looking under every seat, so she felt sad and worried.
why.zh: 第 2、3 段：她看到女孩在哭、在每个座位下面找，所以心里难过、担心。

prompt.en: Write the theme of "The Lost Photo Card" in your OWN words. Remember: no names!
prompt.zh: 用你自己的话写出这个故事的主题。记住：不写名字！

write.model: It feels good to give back something that is not yours.

canNow.en: I can now find the narrator and write a theme with no names.

items.q: Daisy has 3/4 of a bubble tea. She drinks 1/2 of it. What fraction of the whole tea does she drink?

hint.en: Find the key words. "of" or "each day ... in 4 days" means ×. "How many ... in" or "shared equally" means ÷.
hint.zh: 找关键词。“of” 或 “每天……几天一共” 用乘法。“能分成几份” 或 “平均分” 用除法。

steps.en: Circle the key word: "of" means multiply (×).
steps.zh: 圈出关键词：“of” 的意思是乘（×）。

steps.zh: 能约分吗？除了 1，没有数能同时整除 3 和 8，所以已经是最简分数。

why.en: She drinks half OF the 3/4 she has, and "of" means ×.
why.zh: 她喝的是 3/4 的一半，“of” 就是乘。

steps.en: The top divides exactly by the bottom: 24 ÷ 3 = 8.

why.en: We want to know how many 3/4 m pieces fit into 6 m, so we divide.
why.zh: 我们要知道 6 米里能剪出几段 3/4 米，所以用除法。

items.q: Emma swims 3/5 of a kilometre every day. How far does she swim in 4 days?

hint.en: Find the key words. "of" or "each day ... in 4 days" means ×. "How many ... in" or "shared equally" means ÷.
hint.zh: 找关键词。“of” 或 “每天……几天一共” 用乘法。“能分成几份” 或 “平均分” 用除法。

steps.en: Circle the key words: "every day ... in 4 days" means the same amount 4 times, so multiply (×).
steps.zh: 圈出关键词：“每天……4 天一共” 就是同样的量 4 次，用乘法（×）。

steps.en: Write the whole number 4 as a fraction over 1.
steps.zh: 把整数 4 写成分母是 1 的分数。

steps.en: Can we simplify 12/5? No number except 1 divides both 12 and 5, so it is already in simplest form.
steps.zh: 能约分吗？除了 1，没有数能同时整除 12 和 5，所以已经是最简分数。

steps.en: The top is bigger than the bottom, so change it to a mixed number: 12 ÷ 5 = 2 with 2 left over.
steps.zh: 分子比分母大，变成带分数：12 ÷ 5 = 2 余 2。

why.en: She swims the same distance 4 times, so 4 × 3/5.
why.zh: 同样的距离游 4 次，所以是 4 × 3/5。

items.q: 4 friends share 2/3 kg of nuts equally. How much does each friend get?

hint.en: Find the key words. "of" or "each day ... in 4 days" means ×. "How many ... in" or "shared equally" means ÷.
hint.zh: 找关键词。“of” 或 “每天……几天一共” 用乘法。“能分成几份” 或 “平均分” 用除法。

steps.en: Circle the key words: "share equally" means divide (÷).
steps.zh: 圈出关键词：“平均分” 用除法（÷）。

steps.en: Write the whole number 4 as a fraction over 1.
steps.zh: 把整数 4 写成分母是 1 的分数。

steps.en: Simplify. The biggest number that divides both 2 and 12 is 2.
steps.zh: 约分。能同时整除 2 和 12 的最大的数是 2。

why.en: Sharing 2/3 kg between 4 friends makes each share smaller, so we divide by 4.
why.zh: 把 2/3 千克分给 4 个人，每人分得更少，所以除以 4。

items.q: Sophie has 150 baht. She spends 2/5 of it on gel pens. How much does she spend?

hint.en: Find the key words. "of" or "each day ... in 4 days" means ×. "How many ... in" or "shared equally" means ÷.
hint.zh: 找关键词。“of” 或 “每天……几天一共” 用乘法。“能分成几份” 或 “平均分” 用除法。

steps.en: Circle the key word: "of" means multiply (×).
steps.zh: 圈出关键词：“of” 的意思是乘（×）。

steps.en: Write the whole number 150 as a fraction over 1.
steps.zh: 把整数 150 写成分母是 1 的分数。

steps.en: The top divides exactly by the bottom: 300 ÷ 5 = 60.

why.en: She spends 2/5 OF her money, and "of" means ×.
why.zh: 她花了钱的 2/5，“of” 就是乘。

items.q: James has 3 loaves of bread for the class feast. Each child gets 3/8 of a loaf. How many children get bread?

hint.en: Find the key words. "of" or "each day ... in 4 days" means ×. "How many ... in" or "shared equally" means ÷.
hint.zh: 找关键词。“of” 或 “每天……几天一共” 用乘法。“能分成几份” 或 “平均分” 用除法。

steps.en: Circle the key words: "How many ... ?" from a total means divide (÷).
steps.zh: 圈出关键词：“能做/分几个？” 用除法（÷）。

steps.en: Write the whole number 3 as a fraction over 1.
steps.zh: 把整数 3 写成分母是 1 的分数。

steps.en: The top divides exactly by the bottom: 24 ÷ 3 = 8.

why.en: We want to know how many 3/8 pieces fit into 3 loaves, so we divide.
why.zh: 我们要知道 3 个面包能分出几份 3/8，所以用除法。

canNow.en: I can now choose × or ÷ in fraction word problems.
canNow.zh: 我现在可以在分数应用题里选择乘或除。

intro.en: A run-on is two complete sentences joined with nothing, or only a comma. Fix 1: full stop + capital letter. Fix 2: comma + and / but / so.
intro.zh: 连写句是两个完整的句子连在一起，中间没有标点或只有逗号。改法 1：句号 + 大写。改法 2：逗号 + and / but / so。

questions.q: Which one is a RUN-ON sentence?
options: I like bread it is soft.

why.en: "I like bread" and "it is soft" are two complete sentences joined with nothing between them.
why.zh: “I like bread” 和 “it is soft” 是两个完整的句子，中间什么都没有。

questions.q: Which one is a RUN-ON sentence?
options: Tom ran, but he was late.
Tom ran fast, he was late.

why.en: Two complete sentences joined with only a comma is still a run-on. It needs "but" or a full stop.
why.zh: 两个完整的句子只用逗号连起来，还是连写句。需要加 but 或句号。

questions.q: Choose the best fix: Emma loves K-pop she dances every day.
options: Emma loves K-pop, she dances every day.
Emma loves K-pop. She dances every day.
Emma loves K-pop she. Dances every day.
emma loves K-pop. she dances every day.

why.en: Fix 1: full stop + capital letter. "She" starts the new sentence with a capital S.
why.zh: 改法 1：句号 + 大写字母。新句子 She 要大写。

questions.q: Choose the best fix: My grandma smiled she gave me a big hug.
options: My grandma smiled, she gave me a big hug.
My grandma smiled and, she gave me a big hug.
My grandma smiled, and she gave me a big hug.
my grandma smiled. she gave me a big hug.

why.en: Fix 2: comma + and. "My grandma smiled, and she gave me a big hug."
why.zh: 改法 2：逗号 + and。

questions.q: Choose the best fix: I dropped my phone, the screen cracked.
options: I dropped my phone, so the screen cracked.
I dropped my phone the screen cracked.
I dropped, my phone the screen cracked.
I dropped my phone, the Screen cracked.

why.en: A comma alone is not enough. Comma + so joins the two ideas and shows the reason.
why.zh: 只有逗号不够。逗号 + so 把两个意思连起来，还说明了原因。

questions.q:
Which part of a speech is this?
"Have you ever tried to cook something and made a big mess?"

why.en: A question to grab attention is an introduction.
why.zh: 用问题吸引听众，这是开场。

questions.q:
Which part of a speech is this?
"It was Chinese New Year, and I was in Grandma's kitchen."

why.en: It tells WHEN and WHERE. That is the beginning.
why.zh: 它讲了时间和地点，这是开始。

questions.q:
Which part of a speech is this?
"Then, something unexpected happened: my first dumpling burst open in the pot!"

why.en: A problem or surprise is the exciting middle part.
why.zh: 问题或惊喜是最精彩的中间部分。

questions.q:
Which part of a speech is this?
"Finally, Grandma tasted my dumplings and said they were perfect."

why.en: It tells how the story ended. That is the end.
why.zh: 它讲了故事的结果，这是结尾。

questions.q:
Which part of a speech is this?
"I learned that making mistakes is part of learning something new."

why.en: It tells what I learned, not the story again. That is the conclusion.
why.zh: 它讲了我学到什么，不是再讲故事，这是总结。

canNow.en: I can now fix run-on sentences and name the 5 parts of a speech.
canNow.zh: 我现在可以改正连写句，并说出演讲的 5 个部分。

why.zh: both ... and：把两个人加在一起。

items.text: Daisy wanted to swim, ___ the pool was closed.

why.zh: 选择：or。

items.text: It started to rain, ___ we ran inside.

keywords.meaning: keep thinking about your goal and do not give up
you have decided to do something and you will not stop
smiled a very big, happy smile

paragraphs: Emma wanted to swim in the city gala. Her coach said she needed to swim 50 metres in under 40 seconds. Emma was determined. She decided she would practise every morning before school, even when it was cold.

Every day, Emma's arms ached and her legs felt like jelly. By Friday she was exhausted, so tired that she fell asleep on the bus. Her friend Sophie said, "Keep your eyes on the prize. Think about the gala!"
On the day of the gala, the pool was packed with people, and there was no empty seat anywhere. Emma's heart was pounding. The whistle blew and she dived in.
She touched the wall and looked at the clock: 38 seconds! Emma beamed. Her smile was so big that her cheeks hurt. All those cold mornings had been worth it.

questions.q: DETERMINED means...
options: she had decided and would not stop

why.en: Clue: she decided she would practise every morning, even when it was cold.
why.zh: 线索：她决定每天早上练习，即使很冷。

why.zh: 没有空座位 = 非常满。

questions.q: What does Sophie mean by "Keep your eyes on the prize"?

why.en: It is an idiom. Sophie wants Emma to remember her goal.
why.zh: 这是习语。Sophie 想让 Emma 记住目标。

questions.q: Did Emma reach her goal?

why.en: Her goal was under 40 seconds. 38 is less than 40.
why.zh: 目标是 40 秒以内。38 比 40 少。

intro.en: Characters, setting, problem, events, solution: which one is it?

why.en: Showing (shaking hands) paints a picture. Telling ("scared") does not.
why.zh: “手在发抖”能让人看到画面，只说“害怕”不行。

why.zh: 草稿 = 第一次尝试，之后再检查、修改。

The life of a real scientist

why.en: Fiction = made up. Dragons are not real!
why.zh: 虚构 = 编的。龙不是真的！

questions.q: Lily has 3/4 of a pizza. She eats 1/3 of it. What fraction of the WHOLE pizza does she eat?
Tom has 4 m of ribbon. Each bow needs 1/2 m. How many bows can he make?

why.en: How many ... in ... = divide: 4 ÷ 1/2 = 4 × 2 = 8 bows.

questions.q: Emma swims 2/5 km every day. How far does she swim in 5 days?

why.en: Same amount each day = multiply: 2/5 × 5 = 10/5 = 2 km.

questions.q: 3 friends share 3/4 kg of sweets equally. How much does each get?

why.en: Shared equally = divide: 3/4 ÷ 3 = 3/4 × 1/3 = 3/12 = 1/4 kg.

questions.q: Sophie has 200 baht. She spends 3/4 of it on a phone case. How much does she spend?
A bottle holds 2 litres. Each glass holds 1/4 litre. How many glasses can you fill?
Which word problem needs DIVIDING?
options: How many 1/3 cups are in 2 cups?
She runs 1/4 km each day for 3 days.

why.en: "How many ... in ..." = divide. "Of" and "each day for" = multiply.
why.zh: “……里有几个” = 除法；of 和“每天……共几天” = 乘法。

why.en: Keep, Change, Flip: 1/2 × 4/1 = 4/2 = 2.

questions.q: Does the answer make sense? James eats 1/2 of 1/2 of a cake. He says he ate 1 whole cake.
options: No: 1/2 of 1/2 is 1/4, less than half

why.en: Of means ×: 1/2 × 1/2 = 1/4. Half of a half must be smaller than a half.
why.zh: of 就是 ×：1/2 × 1/2 = 1/4。一半的一半一定比一半小。

canNow.en: I can now choose × or ÷ in fraction word problems.
canNow.zh: 我现在会在分数应用题里选 × 或 ÷。

subtitle.en: 10 questions, try as often as you like

intro.en: Context clues, joining words, -er and -or, story parts and fractions. You can try again as many times as you like.
intro.zh: 上下文线索、连词、-er 和 -or、故事部分和分数。可以做很多次。

questions.q: "The library was SILENT, so quiet that I could hear the clock." SILENT means...

why.en: Clue: so quiet.
why.zh: 线索：so quiet。

questions.q: "Unlike her ANXIOUS brother, Emma felt calm before the test." ANXIOUS means...

why.en: Unlike = opposite of calm.
why.zh: unlike = 和 calm 相反。

questions.q: "We went to the beach ___ it was sunny."

why.en: It gives the reason: because.
why.zh: 说原因：because。

questions.q: "I wanted to buy the photo card, ___ I did not have enough money."

why.en: Something different from what she wanted: but.
why.zh: 和想要的不一样：but。

questions.q: A person who visits is a...

why.en: Visit + -or = visitor.
why.zh: visit + -or = visitor。

questions.q: A person who bakes bread is a...

why.en: Bake ends in e: drop the e, add -er.
why.zh: bake 以 e 结尾：去掉 e，加 -er。

questions.q: "In a castle long ago" is the story's...

why.en: Where and when = setting.
why.zh: 在哪里、什么时候 = 背景。

questions.q: In a story, the part where the problem is fixed is the...

why.en: Solution = how the problem is fixed.
why.zh: 解决 = 问题怎样解决。

questions.q: 2/3 of 12 stickers = ?
Which spelling is correct?

why.en: Congratulate: drop the e, add -ion.
why.zh: congratulate 去掉 e，加 -ion。

canNow.en: I can now use everything from this week by myself.
canNow.zh: 我现在能自己用上本周学的所有内容。

intro.en: Change to improper fractions FIRST. Then multiply.
intro.zh: 先变成假分数，再乘。

canNow.en: I can now multiply mixed numbers.
canNow.zh: 我现在可以做带分数乘法。

questions.q: Change 3 1/4 to an improper fraction.
Change 2 2/5 to an improper fraction.
Change 11/4 to a mixed number.

why.en: 11 ÷ 4 = 2 with 3 left over: 2 3/4.
5/2 × 4/3 = 20/6 = 10/3 = 3 1/3. Trap: 2 1/6 multiplies the parts on their own.

questions.q: Estimate first: 3 1/4 × 1 3/4 is about...

why.en: 3 1/4 is about 3, and 1 3/4 is about 2. 3 × 2 = 6.

questions.q: A cat eats 1 1/3 cans of food a day. How many cans in 6 days?
Lily's gel pen is 5 1/2 inches long. Her ruler is 2 times as long. How long is the ruler?

title.zh: 配对游戏：带分数和假分数

intro.en: Tap a mixed number, then the same amount as an improper fraction.
intro.zh: 先点带分数，再点和它相等的假分数。

canNow.en: I can now change mixed numbers to improper fractions quickly.
canNow.zh: 我现在可以快速把带分数变成假分数。

intro.en: Improper first, then Keep, Change, Flip.
intro.zh: 先变假分数，再“不变、变号、倒过来”。

canNow.en: I can now divide mixed numbers.
canNow.zh: 我现在可以做带分数除法。

questions.q: In 3 3/4 ÷ 1 1/4, which fraction do you flip?

why.en: Change to 15/4 ÷ 5/4. Keep the first, flip only the second: 4/5.
why.zh: 变成 15/4 ÷ 5/4。第一个不变，只把第二个倒过来：4/5。

questions.q: Emma has 6 cups of flour. Each cake needs 1 1/2 cups. How many cakes?

why.en: How many 1 1/2 in 6? 6/1 × 2/3 = 12/3 = 4 cakes.

questions.q: A 7 1/2 m rope is cut into pieces 2 1/2 m long. How many pieces?
Daisy swims 4 laps in 2/3 of an hour. Is 4 ÷ 2/3 bigger or smaller than 4?

why.en: 2/3 is less than 1, so the answer is bigger: 4/1 × 3/2 = 12/2 = 6.

intro.en: Say the answer, then flip to check.
intro.zh: 先说答案，再翻过来检查。

canNow.en: I can now remember the unit facts.
canNow.zh: 我现在记住了单位换算。

intro.en: Big to small: ×. Small to big: ÷.
intro.zh: 大到小：×。小到大：÷。

canNow.en: I can now convert units, even with fractions.
canNow.zh: 我现在可以换算单位，带分数也可以。

questions.q: 4 ft = ? in

why.en: Big to small: multiply. 4 × 12 = 48 in.

questions.q: 3 lb = ? oz
5 pt = ? c
18 in = ? ft

why.en: Small to big: divide. 18 ÷ 12 = 18/12 = 3/2 = 1 1/2 ft.

questions.q: 8 oz = ? lb
12 qt = ? gal

why.en: 1 gal = 4 qt, so 12 ÷ 4 = 3 gal.
why.zh: 1 加仑 = 4 夸脱，所以 12 ÷ 4 = 3 加仑。

questions.q: 2 1/2 yd = ? ft
1 1/2 c = ? fl oz
To change pounds to ounces you...

why.en: Pounds are bigger, so you need more ounces: × 16.
why.zh: 磅比盎司大，换成盎司数字变大：× 16。

questions.q: A baby elephant weighs 1/4 T. How many pounds is that?

intro.en: Read Main Book M5 first. Then do this. You can try again as many times as you like. No calculator.
intro.zh: 先读主课本 M5，再做（可以做很多次）。不用计算器。

canNow.en: I can now multiply mixed numbers on my own.
canNow.zh: 我现在可以自己做带分数乘法。

questions.q: Change 1 3/8 to an improper fraction.
Change 17/5 to a mixed number.

why.en: 17 ÷ 5 = 3 with 2 left over: 3 2/5.

questions.q: A K-pop dance practice lasts 1 3/4 hours. Daisy practises 4 times. How many hours?
Sophie's cat weighs 4 1/2 kg. Her dog is 2 1/2 times as heavy. How heavy is the dog?

intro.en: Read Main Book M5 and M6 first. Then do this. You can try again as many times as you like. No calculator.
intro.zh: 先读主课本 M5 和 M6，再做（可以做很多次）。不用计算器。

canNow.en: I can now choose × or ÷ and work with mixed numbers.
canNow.zh: 我现在可以选对乘或除，并计算带分数。

questions.q: A bubble tea shop uses 2 1/2 bags of tapioca a day. How many bags in 4 days?
James has 5 1/4 m of string. Each bracelet needs 3/4 m. How many bracelets?
Which one will give an answer BIGGER than 8?

why.en: Dividing by a number less than 1 makes it bigger: 8 ÷ 2/3 = 12.
why.zh: 除以小于 1 的数会变大：8 ÷ 2/3 = 12。

intro.en: Read Main Book R6, E4 and E5 first. Then do this. You can try again as many times as you like.
intro.zh: 先读主课本 R6、E4 和 E5，再做（可以做很多次）。

canNow.en: I can now use context clues, joining words and -er / -or.
canNow.zh: 我现在会用上下文线索、连接词和 -er / -or。

questions.q: The kitten was famished, which means very hungry. What does famished mean?

why.en: The sentence tells you: "which means very hungry".
why.zh: 句子直接告诉你：“which means very hungry”。

questions.q: Tom was timid, but his sister was bold and brave. Timid means...

why.en: "but" tells you an opposite is coming. The opposite of brave is shy and scared.
why.zh: “but”表示后面是相反的意思。brave 的反义是胆小。

questions.q: Emma loves citrus fruits, such as lemons, limes and oranges. Citrus fruits are...

why.en: "such as" gives examples: lemons, limes and oranges.
why.zh: “such as”后面是例子：柠檬、青柠和橙子。

questions.q: Choose the best joining word: Daisy was tired, ___ she still went swimming.

why.en: Being tired and still going is a surprise, so use but.
why.zh: 累了还去游泳，是转折，所以用 but。

questions.q: Choose the best joining word: Lily was late ___ she missed the bus.

why.en: Missing the bus is the REASON she was late: because.
why.zh: 错过公交车是迟到的原因：because。

questions.q: Which sentence has the comma in the right place?
options: I love, cats so I visit the cat cafe.
I love cats so, I visit the cat cafe.
I, love cats so I visit the cat cafe.
I love cats, so I visit the cat cafe.

why.en: Two full sentences joined by so: the comma goes before so.
why.zh: so 连接两个完整的句子：逗号放在 so 前面。

questions.q: A person who swims is a...

why.en: Short word ending in one vowel + m: double the m, then add -er.
why.zh: 短词，结尾是一个元音 + m：双写 m，再加 -er。

questions.q: A person who investigates is an...

why.en: Words ending in -ate drop the e and add -or.
why.zh: 以 -ate 结尾的词去掉 e，加 -or。

intro.en: Read Main Book M7 first. Then do this. You can try again as many times as you like. No calculator.
intro.zh: 先读主课本 M7，再做（可以做很多次）。不用计算器。

canNow.en: I can now convert units and use mixed numbers on my own.
canNow.zh: 我现在可以自己换算单位和计算带分数。

questions.q: 5 ft = ? in

why.en: Big to small: 5 × 12 = 60 in.

questions.q: 40 oz = ? lb
3 gal = ? qt
9 ft = ? yd
A recipe needs 3/4 c of milk. Daisy makes 2 1/2 recipes. How many cups?
A notebook is 8 1/2 inches wide. How wide are 2 notebooks side by side, in feet?

why.en: 8 1/2 × 2 = 17 in. Then 17 ÷ 12 = 1 with 5 left over: 1 5/12 ft.

intro.zh: 为 12 月 8 日星期二的数学小测做准备。主课本 M2、M3、M4、M5 和 M6。

canNow.en: I am ready to multiply and divide fractions.
canNow.zh: 我准备好做分数乘除了。

why.en: Top × top: 2 × 3 = 6. Bottom × bottom: 3 × 4 = 12. 6/12 = 1/2.
Keep, Change, Flip: 4/5 × 5/2 = 20/10 = 2.
Improper first: 3/2 × 8/3 = 24/6 = 4.

questions.q: Which is the same as 2/7 ÷ 3/5?

why.en: Keep the first fraction, change ÷ to ×, flip only the second: 2/7 × 5/3.
why.zh: 第一个分数不变，÷ 变 ×，只把第二个倒过来：2/7 × 5/3。

questions.q: Lily has 3/4 of a pizza. She eats 2/3 of it. How much of a whole pizza did she eat?

why.en: "of" means ×. 2/3 × 3/4 = 6/12 = 1/2 of a pizza.

questions.q: Daisy has 4 m of ribbon. Each bow needs 2/3 m. How many bows can she make?
A pool is 25 m long. Emma swims 2 1/2 lengths. How far does she swim?
2 1/4 kg of sweets are shared equally into 3 bags. How much is in each bag?

title.zh: 第 1 天：故事侦探（阅读考试复习）

title.en: Page 1: The 10 Test Words + Which Person?
title.zh: 第 1 页：10 个考试词汇 + 第几人称？

items.q: Match: Point of View
items.right: D: WHO is telling the story

why.en: Point of View = WHO is telling the story.
why.zh: Point of View = 谁在讲故事。

items.q: Match: Perspective
items.right: I: HOW a character sees something, from their own life

why.en: Perspective = HOW a character sees something, from their own life.
why.zh: Perspective = 人物怎样看一件事。

items.q: Match: First Person
items.right: B: the narrator is IN the story: I, me, my, we

why.en: First Person = the narrator is IN the story: I, me, my, we.
why.zh: First Person = 叙述者在故事里：I、me、my、we。

items.q: Match: Second Person
items.right: G: the narrator talks straight to the reader: you, your

why.en: Second person = the narrator talks to YOU, the reader.
why.zh: 第二人称 = 叙述者直接对“你”（读者）说话。

items.q: Match: Third Person Objective
items.right: J: outside narrator, knows NOBODY's feelings (a camera)

why.en: Objective = like a camera.
why.zh: 客观 = 像摄像机。

items.q: Match: Third Person Limited
items.right: E: outside narrator, knows ONE character's feelings

why.en: Limited = one mind.
why.zh: 有限 = 一个人的想法。

items.q: Match: Third Person Omniscient
items.right: H: outside narrator, knows ALL characters' feelings

why.en: Omni = all.
why.zh: omni = 全部。

items.q: Match: Narrator
items.right: A: the one who is telling the story

why.en: The narrator is the storyteller.
why.zh: 叙述者就是讲故事的人。

items.q: Match: Dialogue
items.right: F: the words characters say, inside " "

why.en: Dialogue is inside speech marks.
why.zh: 对话在引号里。

items.q: Match: Theme
items.right: C: the life lesson of the story (NOT a summary)

why.en: Theme = the lesson.
why.zh: 主题 = 道理。

items.q: We packed our swimming bags and ran to catch the school bus.

why.en: Clue words: we, our.
why.zh: 线索词：we、our。

items.q: Have you ever eaten durian? You will never forget the smell!

why.en: Clue words: you.
why.zh: 线索词：you。

items.q: Sophie bought a photo card of her favourite singer. She smiled all the way home.

why.en: Clue words: Sophie, her, she.
why.zh: 线索词：Sophie、her、she。

items.q: "You are my best friend!" Lily told Emma. Then they hugged.
"I won, I won!" Tom shouted. He held his gold medal high.

why.en: Cover "I won". Clue words left: Tom, he.
why.zh: 遮住 “I won”。剩下的线索词：Tom、he。

title.en: Page 2: Whose Feelings Do I Know? + Perspective
title.zh: 第 2 页：我知道谁的感受？+ 看法

items.q: James and Tom carried the bread to the hall. They put it on the long table.

why.en: Only actions, no feelings: like a camera.
why.zh: 只有动作，没有感受：像摄像机。

items.q: Lily wanted to sing on stage, but she was scared her voice would shake.

why.en: We only know what ONE person thinks or feels. One person = limited.
why.zh: 我们只知道一个人的想法或感受。一个人 = 有限。

items.q: Daisy felt proud of her drawing. Emma felt a little jealous, and the teacher was delighted.

why.en: We know the feelings of Daisy, Emma AND the teacher: everyone.
why.zh: 我们知道 Daisy、Emma 和老师的感受：所有人。

items.q: The swimmers dived into the pool. The crowd clapped and cheered.

why.en: Only actions. No thoughts or feelings.
why.zh: 只有动作，没有想法或感受。

items.q: Sophie was nervous about the test, and Lily was worried about her too. Their teacher felt sure they would both do well.

why.en: Three people's feelings: everyone.
why.zh: 三个人的感受：所有人。

items.q: Tom smiled at the new girl. He hoped she would sit next to him at lunch.

why.en: We only know what ONE person thinks or feels. One person = limited.
why.zh: 我们只知道一个人的想法或感受。一个人 = 有限。

items.q: Why does Daisy feel sad about the rain?
items.right: B) Her swimming lesson is cancelled.

why.en: The story says so.
why.zh: 故事里写的。

items.q: Why does Farmer Tom feel happy about the same rain?

why.en: His rice plants are thirsty.
why.zh: 他的稻田需要水。

items.q: What is "perspective"?
items.right: D) how a character sees something

why.en: Perspective = HOW a character sees something, because of their own life.
why.zh: 看法 = 人物怎样看一件事，因为他们自己的经历。

title.en: Page 3: The Lost Photo Card + Theme
title.zh: 第 3 页：丢失的小卡 + 主题

items.q: What is the point of view of "The Lost Photo Card"?

why.en: My, I, me: the narrator is in the story.
why.zh: My、I、me：叙述者在故事里。

items.q: Who is the narrator?

why.en: "My name is Emma."
why.zh: “My name is Emma.”

items.q: How did Emma feel when she FIRST found the card?

why.en: "I was so excited."
why.zh: “I was so excited.”

items.q: Why was the card so special to Sophie?
items.right: A) It was a gift from her sister.

why.en: "My sister gave it to me for my birthday."
why.zh: “My sister gave it to me for my birthday.”

items.q: Which is the BEST theme of the story?
items.right: D) Doing the right thing feels better than keeping what is not yours.

why.en: A theme is a life lesson for EVERYONE.
why.zh: 主题是给每个人的人生道理。

items.q: "Emma gave the card back to Sophie." Theme or summary?

why.en: It tells what happened and has names.
why.zh: 讲发生了什么，还有名字。

items.q: "Be honest, even when nobody is watching." Theme or summary?

why.en: A lesson for everyone, no names.
why.zh: 给每个人的道理，没有名字。

why.en: 3/1 × 2/5 = 6/5. Even better: change it to a mixed number, 1 1/5.
6/15 simplifies to 2/5.

items.q: For 2/3 ÷ 4/5, what do you do FIRST?

why.en: KEEP comes first.
why.zh: 第一步是“不变”。

title.zh: 第 6 页：咖啡馆应用题

items.q: Daisy has 3/4 of a bubble tea. She drinks 1/2 of it. What fraction of the whole tea does she drink?
Lily has 6 metres of ribbon. Each bow needs 3/4 of a metre. How many bows?

why.en: How many ... in? = divide: 6 ÷ 3/4 = 8.

items.q: Emma swims 3/5 km every day. How far in 4 days?
4 friends share 2/3 kg of nuts equally. How much does each friend get?

why.en: Share equally = divide: 2/3 ÷ 4 = 2/3 × 1/4 = 2/12 = 1/6 kg.

items.q: Sophie has 150 baht. She spends 2/5 of it on gel pens. How much?
James has 3 loaves. Each child gets 3/8 of a loaf. How many children get bread?

why.en: How many ... ? = divide: 3 ÷ 3/8 = 3/1 × 8/3 = 24/3 = 8 children.

title.en: Page 1: The 5 Parts of a Speech
title.zh: 第 1 页：演讲的 5 个部分

items.q: Which part of the speech? "Finally, Grandma tasted my dumplings and said they were perfect."
Which part of the speech? "I learned that making mistakes is part of learning something new."
Which part of the speech? "It was Chinese New Year, and I was in Grandma's kitchen."
Which part of the speech? "Have you ever tried to cook something and made a big mess?"
Which part of the speech? "Then, something unexpected happened: my first dumpling burst open in the pot!"

title.en: Page 2: Write the Rest of MY Speech
title.zh: 第 2 页：写完我的演讲稿

items.q: Write the Middle, End and Conclusion of MY speech.
items.right: 2 to 4 sentences for each part, using the starters: Suddenly... / In the end... / This experience taught me that...

items.q: Fix: My grandma smiled she gave me a big hug.
items.right: My grandma smiled, and she gave me a big hug.

why.en: Comma + and joins the two ideas.
why.zh: 逗号 + and 把两个意思连起来。

items.q: Fix: It was my first concert, I felt very excited.
items.right: It was my first concert, so I felt very excited. (or: ...concert. I felt...)

why.en: Fix 1: full stop + capital letter. Fix 2: comma + and / but / so.
why.zh: 改法 1：句号 + 大写。改法 2：逗号 + and / but / so。

items.q: Fix: We got lost in the market we asked a kind lady for help.
items.right: We got lost in the market, so we asked a kind lady for help.

why.en: Joining with "and" fixes it. Even better: add a comma before and.
why.zh: 用 and 连起来就改好了。更好：and 前面加逗号。

items.q: Fix: I dropped my phone, the screen cracked.
items.right: I dropped my phone, and the screen cracked.

why.en: Comma + and: "I dropped my phone, and the screen cracked."
why.zh: 逗号 + and：I dropped my phone, and the screen cracked.

items.q: Fix: The show was over everyone clapped loudly.
items.right: The show was over. Everyone clapped loudly.

why.en: Full stop after "over", then a capital E.
why.zh: 在 over 后面加句号，Everyone 大写。

items.q: Copy one sentence from YOUR speech that you fixed or improved.
items.right: one sentence from your own speech

why.en: This line is for a sentence from your own speech.
why.zh: 这一行要写你自己演讲稿里的一句话。
